label: common_2110_announce_01
text: All right! Let’s jump right into the first round,\neveryone! Who will the fates pair up today?!

label: common_2110_friend_01
text: You’ve got to be kidding me. Up against my little\nChampion buddy right from the first round...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: common_2110_friend_03a
text: Heheh... Yeah, that’s right! That dumbfounded\nexpression is what I wanted to see![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: common_2110_friend_03b
text: Wait, you actually thought I would sign up for\nthis thing? Boy, I guess you really do get me...\r\nNo wonder we’re best buds![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: common_2110_friend_04
text: See, when we went down into Area Zero, it really\ndrove home for me how I need to get stronger.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: common_2110_friend_05
text: So I’ve been off doing some special super-\nserious training with Mabosstiff and my team![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: common_2110_friend_06
text: If we ever end up in trouble again, I want to be\nthere fighting beside you—on the same level.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: common_2110_friend_07
text: So today I’m here to WIN! Even if it might only\nbe by a stroke of luck![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: common_2110_friend_08
text: Get a taste of this! Arven’s here with some spicy\nnew flavor for you![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: common_2110_announce_04
text: And the winner of this first-round battle is...\nChampion [VAR 0x0100(0000)]!

label: common_2110_mobs_01
text: Whoo! All right! That professor’s kid put up a\nheck of a fight!

label: common_2110_mobs_02
text: What a spicy start! And that’s only the first match!

label: common_2110_friend_09
text: Phew, the strength of a Champion is legit! It hurts\nto lose, but I’m proud of you, little buddy![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: common_2110_friend_10
text: Maybe I should think about going around to all\nthose Gyms myself sometime...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: common_2110_friend_11
text: You’d better try just as hard as I would’ve in\nround two, for me![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
